newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall 1.48 pct, testing support.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall 1.48 pct, testing support.

text.p: Istanbul shares lost an average 1.48 percent on Thursday amid continuing political uneasiness to test support awaited at the index's 1,600 level, brokers said. The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed down 24 points at 1,599, bringing two-day losses to 2.6 percent. Trade volume dropped to 17.15 trillion lira from Wednesday's 20.88 trillion.

The market awaits Friday's National Security Council meeting to be attended by chiefs of the secularist military and Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan. Tension expected to be high because of recent public squabbling between the generals and the Islamist wing of the coalition.
"The market is nervous. Nothing much can be expected until tomorrow's meeting is over," said one dealer.

Of the 237 shares traded, losers outdid gainers sharply by 170 to 28 and 39 closed steady. The IMKB Industrial fell 1.87 percent to 1,631, the IMKB Services dived 2.46 percent to 1,427 and the IMKB Financial eased 0.47 percent to 1,681.

Actives were again led by largely state-owned firms -- flat steel giant Eregli, down 500 lira at 21,500 and petroleum refiner Tupras, down 2,000 lira at 62,000. They made up 21.8 percent of the total turnover.
